title: Async job
description: A durable inference job (specs/52). Durable-first: long-running inference is a job, never a held-open request. Result by reference: the result is an artifact reference (result_ref), not an inline body. Circumvention control: durable jobs observe the same admission, capacity, fairshare, and owner-priority controls as synchronous inference and do not bypass them. Family-typed: every job names its runtime family (specs/48 registry). Resumable: an interrupted job resumes from durable progress after a restart.

family.description: Runtime family from the specs/48 registry; the job controller routes the job to an admitted runtime of this family under the same admission, capacity, fairshare, and owner-priority controls as synchronous inference.

result_ref.description: Result by reference: artifact in the artifact cache model.
